evidence.excerpt: Adopting Bernecker’s (2010) terminology, authenticity refers to the correspondence between the memory representation and the subject’s experience of the past event, while truth refers to the correspondence between the memory representation and the past event itself.

sources.annotation: Separates fidelity to an earlier experience from truth about the past event that experience represented.
